# Sofía Treviño

**HBS '27 · from Monterrey · met at the Harvard Mexas dinner** — warm

## Who
Second-year MBA. Before HBS, three years at a family office in Monterrey (industrial holdings), which is why she heard *"200-person manufacturer"* and lit up. Lives in Cambridge; runs the Mexas dinners with two classmates.

## What she offered
An intro to a **Boston family office** that owns three operating businesses in New England and is looking at AI for ops, not for software.

## What you owe her
Your **one-pager**. You said *"I'll send it this week"*. The warm follow-up agent drafted it; it is in Outreach today.

## Why she matters
Subsidiarity: she is the one person in your Boston network who has sat on the money side of a family office. Before the intro, ask her what they care about most: operating businesses or software.

## Log
- Mexas dinner, last Saturday — met over dessert; she asked three questions about Ferra and none about Bentley. Offered the intro without being asked.
- Yesterday — Exo added her to the CRM from the dinner recording (New people, 3:06).

## Next
Send the one-pager today. Two lines, no pitch. Ask the one question.
